purpose: Track missing knowledge required before deterministic HOME-centric execution.
confidence_definition: current_confidence is confidence that a complete deterministic answer is presently supported, from 0.0 to 1.0.

confirmed_knowledge.description: HOME is the only strategic decision state.
Planner output is limited to VOCAL, REST, SKILL, or AUDITION.
Each planner decision authorizes exactly one room objective.
Success and persistent-state commit require fresh verified HOME.
UNKNOWN cannot commit completion or authorize another planner decision.
Two independent Season 1 decisions support HOME to PRODUCE_MENU through produce_start.
Seven independent occurrences identify battle_auto_on as a named battle action.

candidate_knowledge.description: Season 1 defaults to VOCAL and may use AUDITION near season end when the fan target is unmet.
Season 2 completes the required 10000 audition once, otherwise uses VOCAL, and rests when stamina requires.
Season 3 prioritizes required SKILL, then required auditions, then VOCAL, with REST for insufficient stamina.
Season 4 prioritizes required large auditions and otherwise uses VOCAL.
Each room should execute one supplied objective and return SUCCESS_HOME, FAILED, or UNKNOWN.
Two Season 1 HOME decisions selected produce_start with adequate stamina and an unmet fan target.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The exact Season 1 weeks_remaining threshold for near season end is unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: VOCAL versus AUDITION cannot be selected deterministically when the fan target is unmet.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A human-authored rule or reviewed HOME decision demonstrations for every relevant late-season week.

unresolved_unknowns.description: Season 1 behavior when stamina is insufficient is unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The default policy may choose an objective that should be preceded by REST.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A human rule or Season 1 HOME demonstration with insufficient stamina.

unresolved_unknowns.description: Eligibility and timing for the required Season 2 10000 audition are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The planner could select an unavailable audition or delay a required objective.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Season 2 HOME observations and demonstrations before, during, and after the 10000 audition becomes available.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The required Season 3 skill objectives and their order are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: SKILL cannot receive a deterministic fixed objective.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-authored required-skill list plus demonstrations showing each objective and verified completion.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The complete Season 3 audition targets, order, and eligibility rules are not fully validated.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: AUDITION cannot receive a deterministic target after SKILL work.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Reviewed HOME observations, fixed target list, and complete demonstrations for every required Season 3 audition.

unresolved_unknowns.description: Season 4 large audition targets, order, and eligibility are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The planner cannot identify which AUDITION objective has priority.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-authored Season 4 target list and HOME-to-HOME demonstrations for each target.

unresolved_unknowns.description: Season 4 behavior when stamina is insufficient is unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The planner lacks a deterministic REST rule for this condition.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A human rule or Season 4 HOME demonstration with insufficient stamina.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The response when a required objective is pending but unavailable is unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The planner cannot safely select a fallback without inventing strategy.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-authored fallback rules and HOME observations where required objectives are unavailable.

unresolved_unknowns.description: It is unresolved whether the reliable HOME input is fan_count, fan_target, or fan_gap_to_target.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Planner fan conditions cannot be evaluated from ambiguous or invented values.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Repeated labeled HOME observations across seasons with independently verified fan values and target status.

unresolved_unknowns.description: A reliable VOCAL_RESULT observation is absent from the analyzed demonstration.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: VOCAL completion cannot be distinguished reliably from animation or unrelated transitions.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A clean vocal demonstration with labeled result observations, screenshots, and transition trace through HOME.

unresolved_unknowns.description: No demonstrated REST progress or result anchors are established.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: REST cannot prove that its objective executed before HOME reappears.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A complete REST demonstration with labeled observations, screenshots, and trace from HOME to fresh HOME.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The skill-room exit and return-to-HOME observations are not established.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: SKILL cannot close its lifecycle or report SUCCESS_HOME reliably.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A complete skill demonstration with labeled post-purchase, exit, transition, and fresh HOME observations.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The relationship among battle completion, AUDITION_RESULT, result dialogue, season result, and HOME is not fully resolved.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: AUDITION may commit too early or fail to recognize a valid result path.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Complete audition traces with labeled screenshots and observations for each distinct result path.

unresolved_unknowns.description: A clean, uninterrupted VOCAL lifecycle from verified HOME to fresh HOME is not demonstrated.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The room's intermediate transitions and exit proof cannot be finalized.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: One or more complete vocal demonstrations with named action, result, transition handlers, and final HOME trace.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The REST lifecycle and intermediate transitions are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: A HOME-to-HOME state label alone cannot prove rest occurred.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A complete REST demonstration including before HOME values, room progress, result, and fresh HOME values.

unresolved_unknowns.description: It is unknown whether one SKILL cycle performs one operation or all eligible required operations.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The room cannot know when its supplied objective is complete.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-authored scope rule plus demonstrations with multiple available skill operations.

unresolved_unknowns.description: No complete validated AUDITION lifecycle exists for every required target.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Target selection, battle, result handling, and HOME return cannot be composed deterministically.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: A separate complete HOME-to-HOME demonstration and trace for every required audition target and result path.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The exact dialogue, continue, speed, and fixed-choice handlers allowed in each room are not fully validated.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Over-broad handling risks unauthorized transitions; under-broad handling causes avoidable stops.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Reviewed room traces identifying each handler occurrence, its room context, expected result, and retry bound.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The complete audition flag set and season-reset behavior are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Required auditions may repeat or be skipped after process restart or season change.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-approved flag definitions plus traces showing when every flag is committed and reset.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The required skill flags, granularity, and season-reset behavior are unknown.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The planner cannot determine whether required SKILL work remains.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human-approved skill-goal list and traces linking verified skill effects to flag commits.

unresolved_unknowns.description: It is unknown whether an audition is complete on entry, battle resolution, result display, or victory.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Persistent audition flags cannot be committed safely.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Human definition plus success and failure demonstrations showing the authoritative completion evidence.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The required proof of vocal completion and one-week consumption is not fully validated.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: A return to HOME could be associated with an incomplete or unrelated transition.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Clean vocal traces with result evidence and consistent before/after HOME week observations.

unresolved_unknowns.description: It is unknown whether REST success requires verified stamina improvement or another effect beyond fresh HOME.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The system could report successful rest without evidence that rest occurred.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: REST demonstrations with before/after stamina observations and an authoritative human completion rule.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The complete set of acceptable SKILL completion effects is unknown beyond observed resource decrease.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: Some valid skill operations may be rejected or unverified operations may be committed.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Demonstrations for each required skill type with before/after resource, flag, or result evidence.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The required handling when a room crosses a season-result or season-clear transition before HOME is not fully specified.
unresolved_unknowns.why_it_matters: The executor may stop before HOME or commit a room against the wrong season context.
unresolved_unknowns.required_evidence: Complete cross-season traces through result states to the next fresh HOME, with human confirmation of commit timing.
